title: Loyalty That
Levels Up
hero.lede: Our tiered customer loyalty program rewards you every time you visit. The higher your tier, the bigger the perks.

how.title: How It Works
how.text: Every purchase earns you points toward your next tier. Accumulate enough and your account advances automatically — unlocking better discounts, exclusive deals, and priority perks. Tiers are evaluated on a rolling basis so your status always reflects your recent activity.

items.name: Bronze
perks: Birthday discount — 15% off on your birthday
Early access to weekly deal notifications

items.name: Gold
perks: First access to new product drops and limited releases
Complimentary product sample on qualifying visits
Dedicated Gold member line during peak hours

steps.title: In Person at the Register
steps.text: Ask any budtender or cashier to sign you up when you check in. We'll create your loyalty account on the spot — all you need is a valid 21+ ID. Your points start accumulating immediately on your first qualifying purchase.

steps.title: Via Your Dutchie Account
steps.text: Already have a Dutchie account? Your loyalty membership will be linked automatically once the program launches. No Dutchie account yet? Create one free at
steps.after: — it also makes online ordering and express pickup faster.

launch.title: Program Launching Soon
launch.text: Our tiered loyalty program is being finalized and will roll out in the coming months. Visit us in store to get on the early-access list and be among the first enrolled when we go live.
